enable_large_save_load_buffer.description: Opt in to a measured 64 KiB buffered save reader. Preserves vanilla checksum preflight and load semantics. Restart required.

save_load_buffer_kib.description: Buffered save-reader size in KiB. Local benchmark plateaued at 64 KiB. Restart required.

enable_streaming_save_compression.description: Opt in to streaming gzip directly into CoI's seekable temporary save file. Preserves post-write validation and atomic rename. Restart required.

skip_uncompressed_save_checksum.description: Skip the redundant uncompressed CRC pass when streaming saves. Compressed CRC and post-write validation remain enabled. Restart required.

enable_low_product_textures.description: Opt in to a lower-resolution product texture-array mode through CoI's normal rebuild path. Restart required.

product_texture_mip_bias.description: 3 = Low, 4 = Very Low. CoI's existing 64 px minimum slice size remains enforced.

enable_manual_asset_trim.description: Enable the paused-only trim_unused_assets console command. The action is never run automatically.
